CREATE TRIGGER `imc_mr_managers_imc006_ai` AFTER INSERT ON `IMC006_Match_Reports` FOR EACH ROW UPDATE `IMC006_Results` r SET r.home_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.home_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.home_sm_manager_id,r.home_sm_manager_id), r.away_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.away_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.away_sm_manager_id,r.away_sm_manager_id) WHERE r.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND r.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id AND (NOT(r.home_sm_manager_id <=> IF(NEW.home_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.home_sm_manager_id,r.home_sm_manager_id)) OR NOT(r.away_sm_manager_id <=> IF(NEW.away_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.away_sm_manager_id,r.away_sm_manager_id)))

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_mr_managers_imc006_au` AFTER UPDATE ON `IMC006_Match_Reports` FOR EACH ROW UPDATE `IMC006_Results` r SET r.home_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.home_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.home_sm_manager_id,r.home_sm_manager_id), r.away_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.away_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.away_sm_manager_id,r.away_sm_manager_id) WHERE r.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND r.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id AND (NOT(r.home_sm_manager_id <=> IF(NEW.home_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.home_sm_manager_id,r.home_sm_manager_id)) OR NOT(r.away_sm_manager_id <=> IF(NEW.away_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.away_sm_manager_id,r.away_sm_manager_id))) AND (NOT(NEW.home_sm_manager_id <=> OLD.home_sm_manager_id) OR NOT(NEW.away_sm_manager_id <=> OLD.away_sm_manager_id))
